required_laws: Access is available only in the Street aperture.
Every Access geometry object is a semantic feature inventory bound to the SHA-256 identity of the exact displayed scene.
Occluded or unverified connections remain absent rather than being completed by interpolation.
Map-only and held states render zero image geometry.
Shade and Water render source and field-verification questions until separately classified semantic receipts exist.
Unsupported instruments and source modes refuse selection.
Export preserves exact asset identity, semantic receipt identity, feature inventory, seat, authority, and public-effect boundary.
